Description: AI Longevity Pro campaign service (marketing plane, leads only): Dittofeed v0.23.0 with its Postgres, ClickHouse and Temporal, the sign-up service and the SES events function, in a network of its own with no route to the clinical plane. Written and validated; NOT applied. Services start at 0 tasks.

SendingSubdomain.Description: Brandon's decision, empty until made: the dedicated subdomain SES verifies for marketing mail only (never the clinical domain's sending identity). Empty creates no identity, and the sign-up service refuses to send.

CampaignTracking.Description: Brandon's decision, empty until made: whether open and click events are recorded. Must equal the service's CAMPAIGN_TRACKING. Empty records neither and the service refuses to send.

CampaignFromName.Description: Brandon's decision, empty until made: the sender name. Passed to the service as CAMPAIGN_FROM_NAME.

CampaignMailingAddress.Description: Brandon's decision, empty until made: the physical mailing address printed in every email (CAMPAIGN_MAILING_ADDRESS).

CampaignApprovedTextVersion.Description: The text version Brandon approved (CAMPAIGN_APPROVED_TEXT_VERSION); the service sends nothing unless it is the current one.

PublicHostName.Description: The campaign service's public host name (sign-up, confirmation and unsubscribe pages). The Desktop's CAMPAIGN_SIGNUP_ORIGIN is https://<this>.

LeadSignupImage.Description: The sign-up service image (infra/lead-campaigns/lead-signup.Dockerfile), in this account's ECR, pinned by digest.

DittofeedLiteImage.Description: Dittofeed, pinned to release v0.23.0 (commit fe2b311643f63cad4c9851a87359d1ed0b152070), or that release mirrored into this account's ECR by digest.

TemporalImage.Description: Temporal, the version Dittofeed v0.23.0's own lite compose file runs, or its ECR mirror by digest.

ClickHouseImage.Description: ClickHouse, the version Dittofeed v0.23.0's own compose file runs, or its ECR mirror by digest.

SesEventsCodeBucket.Description: Bucket holding the SES events function bundle (dist/lead-campaigns/ses-events).

LongevityProgramGroupId.Description: The Longevity Program's OPT-IN subscription group, created in Dittofeed.

WeightLossProgramGroupId.Description: The weight loss program's OPT-IN subscription group.

DiabetesProgramGroupId.Description: The diabetes program's OPT-IN subscription group.

DesiredTaskCount.Description: 0 creates the services stopped. Raised to 1 only after review, Brandon's go-ahead, and the settings above.

DittofeedBootstrap.Description: Dittofeed's first-start bootstrap; set to false after the first start, as its compose file says.

VpcCidr.Description: The campaign network's own range. It is never peered or attached to anything.

CountsReaderCidr.Description: The Desktop server's egress range, the only source that may read /internal/counts (counts only, with the bearer token as well). Empty: the counts are not reachable and the Campaigns screen says it cannot reach the service.

Properties.Description: Dittofeed single-tenant dashboard password (the open-source build has no per-person sign-in)
Sign-up confirmation-link key (base64, at least 32 bytes)

CampaignSignupOrigin.Description: The Desktop's CAMPAIGN_SIGNUP_ORIGIN, once DNS points PublicHostName at the load balancer.
